name: detect_beats
description: Measure a music bed's tempo, beat grid, first downbeat and energy sections (drop, breakdown). Pure ffmpeg plus Python, no model or credentials. Assumes a steady tempo and reports how sure it is.

input.description: Music file, or a video whose first audio stream is the music

output.description: {input, duration, method, bpm, bpm_confidence (0-1, on-beat vs sixteenth positions; below 0.3 sets warning no_clear_pulse), bpm_hint, beat_period (s), first_beat (first grid beat at or after the first audible sound), beats (every grid beat from first_beat; beats before downbeat are a pickup), beats_per_bar, downbeat (first bar one), downbeat_confidence (0-1), downbeat_source (energy_change | accent | first_beat; first_beat means no cue was sure and bar one is assumed to start on the first beat), bar_length (s), bars (bar starts, bars[0] == downbeat), sections [{start, end, bar_start, bar_end, energy: high|mid|low|silent, loudness_db}], events [{type: drop|breakdown|intro|outro, t, bar}], tempo_stability_ms (RMS deviation of detected beats from the grid), warning (null | no_clear_pulse | tempo_drift)}. Times are seconds in the input file; bar indices are 0-based from downbeat.

params.name: bpm-hint
params.description: The BPM you requested or expect. Picks the octave (double or half time); a hint a few percent off does not move the measured tempo.

params.name: out
params.description: Write the JSON to this file instead of printing it, and print {"path": "<abs path>"} instead
